text:
sara: deploy-bot just flagged and blocked the canary publish for release/2026.03.20 — ECR rejected the push due to missing provenance annotation :exclamation: (deploy-bot message below)

deploy-bot: [publish halted] image redwood/runtime:2026.03.20-canary failed provenance check: manifest annotation 'io.redwood.provenance' not found. Holding rollout. See logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/47823

ben: :eyes: any idea why the annotation wasn't included? Build step ran cosign in the pipeline as usual.

jordan: I pulled the image manifest from the build artifact registry, looks like the overlay step that injects provenance metadata ran after the image push to ECR. Build order bug — overlay writes annotations to the build artifact but we pushed the image before that step completed.

ben: ugh. That explains the missing annotation on the published manifest. Pipelines are async when the overlay job is flagged incremental.

ops-oncall: Can we retag and republish without a full rebuild? We need the canary window in 30m.

jordan: We can graft a new manifest with the annotation and push to ECR using gcrane/cosign, but ECR attestation expects a matching digest and signed attestation. If we modify manifest locally we must ensure cosign signs the exact digest we push. Plan: pull existing manifest+layers, add annotation JSON blob, sign with cosign, then put-image with the same digest. I'll sketch commands.

jordan: ```bash
# fetch manifest
GCR_IMAGE=us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:2026.03.20-canary
mkdir tmp-manifest && cd tmp-manifest
gcrane manifest pull $GCR_IMAGE > manifest.json
# merge overlay annotations from artifact store
jq -s '.[0] * {"annotations": .[1].annotations}' manifest.json ../overlays/2026.03.20-annotations.json > new-manifest.json
# push signed manifest (cosign expects the image name)
cosign sign --key cosign.key --annotations-file ../overlays/2026.03.20-annotations.json $GCR_IMAGE
# then use aws ecr put-image with the manifest body (ensure digest matches)
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-manifest file://new-manifest.json --image-tag 2026.03.20-canary
```

ben: That flow can work but we must be careful: if the digest changes because the manifest canonicalization differs, ECR will accept but the attestation may not match what our provenance guard expects.

sara: Is there an easier fallback? Roll back the canary to previous stable digest? That keeps the service up but delays the release.

ops-oncall: I'd prefer rollback if it buys us time to validate a fix. Canary window is small and customers are live on that path.

jordan: OK. Quick plan: 1) rollback canary to tag stable@sha256:abc123def (existing pinned digest) 2) update release notes and add incident note: "publish blocked by late metadata overlay; reprovisioned pipeline order" 3) open hotfix branch to fix overlay ordering in CI 4) retest in staging and republish with proper cosign attestation outside the change window.

ben: I'll open the PR and include the CI step reorder + a test that asserts that manifest contains io.redwood.provenance before push. Also will add a guard in the publish job: wait-for-annotation.sh with a 60s timeout.

sara: ops, can you approve rollback? I don't want to risk partial canary failing.

ops-oncall: approving rollback. I'll trigger deploy-bot rollback now. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [rollback initiated] rolling back redwood/runtime:2026.03.20-canary -> stable@sha256:abc123def. Canary scaled down, traffic reverted. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollbacks/9822

jordan: after rollback completes, I'll run the manual manifest graft in a sandbox and verify cosign attestation flow end-to-end. If that succeeds, we can schedule a republish in the next change window.

ben: adding release notes entry and drafting changelog. Will also add a one-liner for support: "Canary publish blocked due to late overlay of provenance metadata; rollout rolled back to stable. Fix in CI pipeline pending."

sara: thanks team. Please add the pinned digest to the release config so deploy-bot can't accidentally pick the unannotated tag again. :lock:

jordan: done — updated deploy-config repo with pin and added a prepublish check. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/deploy-config/pulls/412

ben: :shipit: good followups. After the fix we should add an integration check that verifies cosign attestation TTL and manifest annotations as part of the release checklist.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor after republish. For now incident ticket created: INC-2026-332.

sara: closing this thread, we'll reconvene once the sandbox republish passes. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
